method: Complete recursive TypeScript AST runtime/type/import/re-export/import-type/import-equals/literal dynamic-import edges. Full-file closure is a conservative barrel superset; selected closure follows actual named re-exports through declaration-free barrels. emittedRuntimeModules separately use TypeScript 5.9.3 import erasure (ESNext, JSX preserve, verbatimModuleSyntax false) to distinguish imports used only as types despite runtime import syntax. This projection is scope evidence, not the original build or manual symbol/body review. Non-barrel bodies remain whole modules. External package entry points stay explicit; this graph is not manual body review or implementation acceptance.
